title: Forge Arena protocol v1 draft
description: Task 1.1 catalog contract. Open questions in schema.md section E are deliberately not silently resolved. Additional properties remain allowed on message envelopes until these gaps are decided.

Int32.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/trackable/TrackableObject.java:47 — Java int; individual semantics may further restrict values.

CardRef.$comment: Plan 3.3: visible integer ids; hidden per-seat opaque string ids. Never send Forge hidden ids as a substitute for IdMapper.

PlayerRef.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/GameEntityView.java:16 — PlayerView inherits the integer identity; seat index is a different concept.

Sequence.$comment: Plan 3: monotonic per-seat seq/clientSeq/baseSeq. Counter width and rollover are unspecified (E13).

RequestId.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/IIdentifiable.java:4 — Existing IdentifiableNetEvent inherits this correlation type; JSON id lifetime/reconnect policy still needs E13.

EntityRef.$comment: Plan 3.3 chosen/attackTargets show playerId and planeswalkerId; cardId is the generic card reference. Battle and stack target tagging remains E8.

Counters.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/GameEntityView.java:76 — Counts are integers; CounterType wire key spelling remains E8.

num.$comment: Plan 3.3 gives string collector number; exact lookup deferred to task 1.2.

blocking.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/card/CardView.java:241 — Boolean in CardView; blocker-to-attacker arrows need an additional representation (E8).

attackTarget.$comment: Plan 2.5 names attackTarget; GameView.getCombat() supplies the combat graph, mapping pending task 1.2/E8.

VisibleCard.$comment: Visibility is decided server-side with CardView.canBeShownTo and canFaceDownBeShownTo. Optional fields support partial public card data; see E8 for final required fields.

blocking.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/card/CardView.java:241 — Boolean in CardView; blocker-to-attacker arrows need an additional representation (E8).

attackTarget.$comment: Plan 2.5 names attackTarget; GameView.getCombat() supplies the combat graph, mapping pending task 1.2/E8.

Card.$comment: AnyOf permits identifiable face-down cards as well as identity-free face-down public objects. Schema cannot enforce per-seat visibility; serializer tests must do so.

commanderDamage.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/player/PlayerView.java:346 — Keys in plan example look like player ids, but Forge queries by commander CardView; E8.

StackItem.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/spellability/StackItemView.java:146 — Also getTargetPlayers/getTargetStackItems; flat plan targets cannot distinguish these namespaces (E8).

kind.$comment: Plan 2.2/3.3 spell declareAttackers, declareBlockers, select, waiting. Names and payloads for priority, targeting, mana payment, and mulligan remain E7; not invented here.

ActiveInput.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/Selection.java:13 — min/max/cards/targets/chosen source; selectable field spelling and stack refs need E7/E8 approval. Only kind is universally required because waiting has no choice payload.

StateSnapshot.$comment: Plan 3.3 full per-seat shape, not the Phase 0 WsServer opening-hand placeholder. Null active/priority/phase supports pre-game/transition state; GameView.java:99 getPhase and :106 getPlayerTurn may be unset. Designation getters deferred to task 1.2.

PromptOption.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gui/interfaces/IGuiGame.java:189 — Arbitrary T, GameEntityView, PaperCard, and byte targets require a tagged option encoding; E5. No Java serialization or function bodies are JSON payloads.

PromptResult.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gui/interfaces/IGuiGame.java:44 — Result is correlated with the pending prompt, including generic choices, maps and OrderResult; full wire encoding remains E5.

skipPhases.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/YieldStateSnapshot.java:28 — Object-keyed map; JSON encoding pending E6.

YieldSeed.$comment: forge-gui/src/main/java/forge/gamemodes/match/YieldStateSnapshot.java:21 — Field names copied from public record because plan only says snapshot; map encoding remains E6.

YieldUpdate.$comment: Plan 2.6: player inferred from authenticated seat and atOrPastAtClick computed server-side. Authoritative yieldState may need additional fields; see E6.

ZoneRef.$comment: forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/zone/ZoneView.java:11 — Record fields retained as draft encoding; final event payload mapping is task 1.8/E9.

items.$comment: Plan 3.1: seats, names, deck status and ready flags. No Forge Arena Lobby DTO yet; nesting and status enum need E11.

lobby.$comment: E11: seats is described by the plan; exact payload field layout is unresolved.

deckResult.$comment: E11: parsed commander and count are required concepts but their field names/shape are unspecified; no fabricated DTO.

state.$comment: Plan 3.3 full per-seat shape, not the Phase 0 WsServer opening-hand placeholder. Null active/priority/phase supports pre-game/transition state; GameView.java:99 getPhase and :106 getPlayerTurn may be unset. Designation getters deferred to task 1.2.

result.$comment: Plan 3.1a/task 1.8; event-specific result encoding unresolved E9. Coin bool, numeric die int and planar enum are source-backed below.
forge-game/src/main/java/forge/game/event/GameEventRollDie.java:5 — int result plus optional PlanarDice; exact planar encoding and die-size field name E9.

log.$comment: E2: type is already const log; GameEventAddLog.type is a GameLogEntryType and cannot share that key. Category field unresolved.

logTail.$comment: Plan 3.1 mentions logTail on reconnect/resync but gives no envelope or entries field name. E2 asks whether it is a message or bundled field; this reserves the mentioned type without inventing payload fields.

message.$comment: Plan 7.8 defines level rejected; remaining info/error level spellings unspecified (E3).

clock.$comment: Plan 3.1: per-seat remainingMs integer and running boolean, but container/id fields and timer source do not exist in this bridge yet (E11).

join.$comment: seatToken is used on reconnect; first-join issuance/response and envelope sequencing remain E11/E13.

lobbySettings.$comment: Plan values/default 40; update/replace semantics and mixed clock representation require E11.

macroRepeat.$comment: Plan 3.2 repeats the parameterless method, stopping if a prompt opens; maximum count needs E13.

nextGame.$comment: NextGameDecision.java:3 has NEW, CONTINUE, QUIT; rematch mapping remains E4.

describeAbility.$comment: E1: Forge returns String but no reply message is defined in plan.
